description: This file is a shell script used for self-healing and connectivity testing on a router or network device. It performs functionalities such as resetting the device, running ping and DNS ping tests, and taking corrective actions based on test results.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current corrective action state from syscfg.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay time for starting the ping tests.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by invoking dmcli.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Triggers a router reset if specified process is ping.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS ping test and takes corrective action if DNS resolution fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs network ping test to default gateway and resets device if ping fails.
